exposure: Low-risk profile (no pre-existing diabetes/hypertension, smoking, prior spontaneous/therapeutic abortion, diagnosed infertility, inadequate prenatal care, low income, rural residence, or obesity)
Population average values of all risk factors
outcome: Risk of maternal mortality or severe morbidity
cohort: 203,414 nulliparous women in British Columbia, Canada, from 2004 to 2014
finding: While risks of various pregnancy complications increased with maternal age, absolute risks for severe outcomes remained low for women aged 35 and 40.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery risk increased linearly with maternal age in the study of nulliparous women.
